scope: Tampa Bay expansion released in the alpha.2 line and republished with the artifact-version correction as v0.1.0-alpha.3. It was verified in the populated development checkout. The source distribution starts empty and the hosted preview is separate. No resident data, raw source excerpts, machine paths or private hosting identifiers are included in this aggregate record.

coverage.development_archive: Tampa only, after official boundary verification

production_browser.note: All 15 application cases passed without retries. Resident, accessibility, asset, CSP and response-policy checks used the built static-assets route. Stalled-upload checks used the identical compiled Worker through a direct no-assets route and verified a following health request. This isolates a reproduced local ProxyWorker defect; it is not a hosted Cloudflare test or evidence that the proxy defect is fixed.

live_built_http.scope: Three fixed public civic locations; official live GIS, snapshot narrative answers, and two non-Tampa development-coverage requests with a spoofed Tampa context. No real-model calls or external deployment.

source_distribution.scope: Regional scopes and fetch configuration retained; zero initial evidence and not_run reports. Raw snapshots, private history, hosting configuration and screenshots excluded. This is a bounded packaging audit, not a new secret-history scan or external account deployment.

real_model_testing: Not rerun for regional expansion; earlier Ollama/Meta Llama 3 findings apply to the recorded pre-expansion source and corpus.
human_review: Independent human review and manual accessibility/resident testing remain pending.
